BOTTOM, LEFT OF CENTER BOX ------------------ \n\nA zoomed-in map showing the current location of the  ISS and current cloud conditions.\n\n3. BOTTOM, CENTER BOX -----------------\n\nThe space station's current position over the earth (state/province and country) or the name of the body of water, the current time and date, the elevation and speed of the station, and the condition of the video transmission:  Live Now (red box) or Offline (blue box). if the live transmission is offline, archived video will show, either from 46 minutes ago, if available, or of other video taken from the space station. BOTTOM, RIGHT BOX -------------------\n\nIf the live stream is running and it is daytime, this box will show the secondary camera aboard the ISS.
